messages.subject: Rotate plotRefToTarget?
parts:

Is there a way to rotate the plotRefToTarget plots? I have used rotate.coords for landmark placement plots using "flipY" and want my vector plots to be in the same orientation.

parts:
Thanks, worked like a charm!

Field_13_proc<- gpagen(Field_13_3D)
test<-rotate.coords(Field_13_proc$coords, "flipY")
test1<-mshape(test)
plotRefToTarget(test1, test[,,239], method="TPS", label=TRUE, mag=4)
plotRefToTarget(test1, test[,,239], method="vector", label=TRUE, mag=4)
